changes: SDI output no longer hits hardware schedule failures on sources whose muxer carries a large audio-ahead offset: the initial backlog now buffers in software and drains instead of forcing the card into an error, so affected streams play continuously instead of dropping to black.
SDI output recovers by itself if the first seconds of a stream overload the output path; the brief fallback now returns to live automatically.

Routes now stop and restart pipelines gracefully, returning SDI hardware resources immediately instead of leaking them, which prevents the card from running out of video frames after repeated restarts.
Failed source reconnections now back off gradually (up to two minutes) instead of retrying every ten seconds, reducing log noise and hardware churn during upstream outages.
SDI output now locks onto 23.98/24 fps sources at their exact cadence instead of forcing 25 fps, so those streams no longer play at the wrong rate.
SDI framerate detection is now robust against stream-join transients, preventing a wrong rate from being inferred in the first seconds of a stream.
Routes now ride through brief source interruptions: a short upstream gap no longer tears the route down, avoiding the multi-second blackout and mode re-detection while the source is briefly lost.
Improved source error reporting in the logs, making upstream SRT problems easier to diagnose.
Fixed received-packet statistics reading zero on listener sources and reduced repeated log noise.
Fixed SRT-to-SDI routes reconnecting on sources that omit framerate metadata: the SDI output now infers the video framerate, so those streams no longer interrupt the route.
Live Preview on SRT-to-SDI routes now reuses the SDI decoder instead of decoding the stream a second time, substantially reducing CPU use on those routes.
Live Preview thumbnails no longer freeze on sources without periodic keyframes; previews now refresh about once per second regardless of GOP structure.
Fixed Live Preview aborting the pipeline on some AVC/H.264 sources; HEVC previews remain rate-limited and stable.
Destination statistics now attribute connected clients to the correct output and report send rate and round-trip time for listener destinations.
Improved SDI output resilience during source changes: the black fallback now engages only once the selector is linked, preventing a pipeline error that could interrupt the route.
